result.note: A weekly recap with little durable detail; the only test is a statements question on India's diplomatic moves with Russia and China.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's diplomatic engagements in the week ending 24 July 2026:
items: New Delhi summoned Russia's envoy over four seafarers killed off Odessa, its second such summons in six weeks.
Jaishankar pressed Wang Yi on a deficit above USD 100 billion.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The summons over the seafarers killed off Odessa was India's third in six weeks, not its second. In the same week, Jaishankar raised a deficit above USD 100 billion with Wang Yi, while Washington said the trade deal must wait on its own tariff probe.
questions.source: Jaishankar pressed Wang Yi on a deficit above USD 100 billion, and Delhi summoned Moscow's envoy over four seafarers killed off Odessa, its third such summons in six weeks.
